title: AI engine
intro: How much AI work one search run may do, and what your CLI reported it used.

budget.title: Run budget
budget.body: A search run hands at most this many Offers to the AI. The rest are still ranked from the posting's own words and marked "Low confidence: not yet analysed".
budget.label: Offers analysed per run

limits.title: Per-task limits
limits.body: Every AI task stops when it reaches its limit, so a run never burns through your quota. The core enforces these; they include turns, tool calls and wall-clock time.

usage.title: Token usage
usage.body: Run a quick test call to see what your CLI reports about a task. Boba shows what the CLI sends and never estimates the rest.
usage.noEngine: Choose an engine in onboarding first to see its usage.
usage.error: The test call could not run.
